data.one_liner: Allows custom HTTP client authors to integrate requests with the DevTools Network View.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interface for custom HTTP clients implemented outside the Dart SDK to send profiling data to the Flutter DevTools Network View. Client authors populate request and response properties on a profile object when profiling is enabled. This surfaces network activity, headers, and connection details in standard Dart debugging tools.
use_when: You are implementing an HTTP client package or adapter and want DevTools Network View integration
You need to expose custom networking protocol metadata and timings to Flutter DevTools
avoid_when: You are an end user consuming existing HTTP clients (like http or dio)
You want a ready-to-use HTTP client for making API requests
strengths: Enables seamless integration with Flutter DevTools Network View for custom clients
Lightweight package with zero external dependencies
Maintained under the official dart-lang repository ecosystem
weaknesses: Targeted exclusively at client library implementers, not general app developers
Pre-1.0 experimental status with potential for breaking API changes
data.setup_notes: None beyond adding as a dependency in your HTTP client package.
